Quickstart

This page walks through your first Widget project in five minutes. You will create a project folder, write a configuration file and run your first build, then look at the output it produces.

Create a project

Make a new folder and run the init command inside it. Widget writes a starter configuration file called widget.toml with sensible defaults that you can change later.

mkdir hello-widget
cd hello-widget
widget init

Build

Run the build command. The first build downloads the default theme, so it takes a few seconds longer than the builds that follow it. The output goes to the dist folder.
